column4: One native launcher opens eight exhibits on macOS.
Point lights, normal-mapped surfaces and occlusion feed the HDR scene.
One instanced draw submits the active particles. Each instance uses 32 bytes.
The driver rejects the edited shader. The last working program continues drawing.
A valid program replaces the old program at a frame boundary.
Floor, walls, spawn and exit are reproducible from the seed and rules.
Enemies share a distance field and finish their committed movement segments.
An independent process restores the exact positions, random streams and waypoints.
Cursor 600 restores the three pending choices at the same simulation tick.
The new branch chooses Fleet. The original history keeps Vitality.
At Tick 87 the original game records its first kill at normal difficulty.
The same combat event drives HDR and bloom. The HUD draws after tone mapping.
Each exhibit releases its own context and exits before the next launch.
